newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Jan-Jul state spending stable yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Jan-Jul state spending stable yr/yr.

text.p: Primary spending by the Belgian federal state was stable at 681.5 billion francs in the first seven months of 1996, compared to 680.3 billion francs in the year-earlier period, the budget ministry said on Friday.
Corrected for inflation, spending fell 1.7 percent in real terms.
The ministry said in a statement that the two main explanations for this result were a temporary acceleration in payments for hospital stays and subsidies in the social security sector.

The ministry also said that the net balance of Treasury operations, targeted to fall 30.9 billion this year, was already 43.2 billion francs lower in the first seven months. By October it should fall to 56.6 billion, the ministry added.
